title: Nuclear medicine and PET

steps.tx: Skeletal scintigraphy exploits osteoblastic remodelling to detect occult bony lesions. The radiopharmaceutical **Tc-99m MDP** (technetium-99m methylene diphosphonate) localises to bone via chemical **chemisorption** onto crystalline hydroxyapatite matrix, with uptake proportional to regional osteoblastic activity and skeletal blood flow across the skeleton.

steps.tx: Widespread skeletal osteoblastic activity can completely divert radiotracer distribution away from normal clearing organs. A metabolic **superscan** on **bone scintigraphy** demonstrates intensely increased diffuse skeletal uptake with markedly diminished or absent renal and soft-tissue background excretion, caused by diffuse osteoblastic metastases.

left.title: Metabolic Superscan
points: Absent or faint renal and bladder excretion
Caused by prostate metastases or hyperparathyroidism

steps.tx: Positron emission tomography interrogates accelerated neoplastic glycolysis in malignant tissue. The glucose analogue **fluorodeoxyglucose** (F-18 FDG) enters cells via GLUT-1 transporters and undergoes intracellular phosphorylation by **hexokinase** into FDG-6-phosphate, becoming trapped intracellularly as a non-metabolised substrate in active tumour cells.

steps.tx: Targeted radioligand imaging provides exceptional accuracy in prostate malignancy. Diagnostic **PSMA PET** with gallium-68 radiotracers demonstrates superior diagnostic sensitivity and specificity over conventional imaging for detecting early recurrent **prostate adenocarcinoma**, even at low serum PSA levels below 0.5 ng/mL in biochemically failing patients.

steps.tx: Functional thyroid scintigraphy differentiates primary thyrotoxic etiologies based on trapping capacity. Diagnostic **thyroid scintigraphy** shows diffuse homogeneously elevated tracer uptake exceeding 4% in **Graves disease**, whereas subacute granulomatous thyroiditis exhibits severely suppressed tracer uptake under 1% across the thyroid gland.

steps.tx: Renal scintigraphic tracers evaluate distinct physiological filtration and secretory processes. Functional **renal scintigraphy** using Tc-99m MAG3 assesses active proximal tubular secretion and effective renal plasma flow, whereas Tc-99m DTPA clearance directly measures the true **glomerular filtration rate** in clinical practice.

steps.tx: Radionuclide pulmonary imaging identifies ventilation-perfusion mismatch in acute thrombotic vascular occlusion. Diagnostic nuclear **scintigraphy** using inhaled Xe-133 gas or aerosol alongside intravenous Tc-99m albumin detects **pulmonary embolism** when one or more wedge-shaped segmental perfusion defects are identified with normal ventilation across both lungs.

steps.tx: Accurate calculation of decay factors and radiation dosimetry requires precise memorisation of radiotracer kinetics. The physical **half-life** of **Technetium-99m** is 6.0 hours, Fluorine-18 is 110 minutes, Iodine-131 is 8.0 days, and Gallium-68 is 68 minutes in everyday clinical radiological protocols.
